summary: Imunon filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with Streeterville Capital for $10M in gross proceeds via Series A Preferred Stock and secured promissory notes. The transaction closed June 3, 2026. Terms include $2.5M from preferred shares, $2.72M Note A-1, and $5M Note B; half of proceeds collateralized. Proceeds fund R&D and working capital. Advisors not named. The filing reflects a structured debt/equity financing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change is involved. Monitor further capital structure changes.
